definitions.selection: One S2000 method per dataset: highest five-seed mean final ID Macro-F1 among all five methods; tie broken lexicographically. No per-seed oracle or tuning.
definitions.units: Metric levels are fractions; Joint-minus-CIL differences and additive contributions are percentage points.
definitions.contribution: 100*(Joint class F1-CIL class F1)/K; signed contributions sum to the paired Macro-F1 gap. This is an arithmetic decomposition, not a causal attribution to precision or recall.
definitions.aggregation: Arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of exact paired seeds 1,2,3,4,42. Pooled-count ratios are separately labelled and are not means of seed ratios.
definitions.zero_denominator: Undefined precision, recall, F1 and count ratios are null, never zero-filled. A fully empty class has f1_zero_division=true; its separately named macro_f1_term is zero to preserve the original macro averaging convention.
definitions.g4: Old true classes exclude the final task. Errors to Normal take precedence; otherwise newer means introduced strictly later than the true class; remaining errors are other-old-or-same-task. Same-task attacks are not newer. Report all-old and old-attacks-only populations separately.
definitions.normal_fpr: Normal rows predicted as any attack / all Normal rows; paired excess is CIL minus Joint.
definitions.scope: Section23.2 final ID decomposition only; original eight-epoch Joint reused unchanged, not a universal empirical upper bound. No S1 shift, training, hyperparameter selection, causal mechanism or innovation conclusion.
definitions.runtime: Historical Joint mixes local/HPC runtime versions; no hardware-matched timing inference.
